flags.text: "Add inline citation badges with hover and keyboard-focus previews to assistant answers. ([#233](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/233))" - Although #233 initially added these badges, #244 removed that implementation when integrating M9, deferring inline badges to #243. They were subsequently reintroduced by #245 over sanitized Markdown. Listing #233 as a delivered addition misrepresents what remained in the release.

"The frontend redesign changes are now together in v1.9.0. Assistant answers retain Markdown and a Sources list; inline citation badges are not included in this integration." - The integration PR deferred inline badges, but #245 subsequently reintroduced them for v1.9.0. In this release-level wording, saying they are not included is misleading.

"Long board card titles could grow beyond two lines and stretch their cards." - The reported defect targets older Chrome. The available Chrome 149 did not reproduce it: the two-line clamp worked even before the fix.
